Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Rift Step (EC07)

ACTION • Burn 2 • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Self; optionally one adjacent willing ally

Effect: Teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 6 units. You may take one adjacent willing ally, placing it in a legal unoccupied space adjacent to your destination. Both destinations must be within 6 units of your starting space. This teleport does not require a traversable path between start and destination.

Design note: No roll or Surges. Does not grant sight through barriers; neither traveler can take additional creatures.
